languageHint: Changes apply immediately. System follows the desktop language: Simplified Chinese on Chinese systems, English otherwise.
tabEmptyHint: Create or open a console under a datasource on the left
tabExtWarnTooltip: The external file changed or is missing; autosave is paused
tabDragTooltip: Hold Ctrl and drag to reorder consoles
tabExtUnresolved: This file has unresolved external changes; handle them first
modalDeleteConsoleHint: Its .sql file will be deleted too; this cannot be undone
modalUnlinkConsoleHint: Only the binding is removed; the original .sql file stays on disk
modalDeleteWorkspaceHint: Consoles and their .sql files are kept; reopen them from the sidebar
historyFileTooltip: The complete history (up to 5000 entries) is in this file
historyPanelHint: The panel shows the latest 100; open the file above for everything
historyEmpty: No statements have run on this datasource yet
guardExplain: These rules were matched by local deterministic checks, not AI.
guardBlockedBody: This connection blocks high-risk SQL; edit the statement and retry.
guardConfirmBody: Run it anyway? Add a WHERE clause or verify with SELECT first.
installBody: Current version {version}; it will be copied to the location below and added to the app menu.
installDone: Installed {version}; launch it from the app menu
sidebarStartHint: Start with “New Connection” in the top-left
connFormTagPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter; existing tags are searchable
connFormTagsFullPlaceholder: Up to 3 tags; remove one first
connFormBlockGuard: Block high-risk SQL directly (warn by default)
connFormCopyTip: Copy connection info as key: value (includes the plaintext password)
connDeleteHint: Only the configuration is removed; database files stay.
connDeleteConsoles: {n, plural, one {# console and its .sql file will also be deleted} other {# consoles and their .sql files will also be deleted}}
connTimeoutInteger: Query timeout must be a whole number of seconds (0–86400)
folderDeleteHint: {conns} connections and {folders} subfolders will move up one level; connection configuration is kept.
resultReceivedRows: Received {n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
resultAffected: OK — {n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} affected
resultTruncated: Result truncated: over 500 rows or the {mb} MB budget
resultRunHint: Ctrl+Enter runs the statement at the cursor (or the selection)
jsonCopyRawTip: Copy the full raw text (unfolded JSON)
exportRunning: Exporting {format}; do not close the app
exportFullRunning: Exporting all rows as {format}; do not close the app
pageDirty: Commit or discard pending edits before paging
pageUnsupported: Paging failed: the statement cannot be paged
pageNoResult: Paging failed: no result set returned
countUnsupported: Count failed: the statement cannot be counted
exportFullHint: This reruns the statement to read all rows; the data may differ slightly from the screen.
exportExitHint: The export is not finished; quitting leaves an incomplete file.
exportNoTable: Cannot determine the table (multi-table query); INSERT export is unavailable
exportNoStream: This datasource does not support streaming export
keymapInvalid: Shortcut “{label}” is invalid ({err}); using the default
keymapRecordingHint: Press the new combination for “{label}” (Esc cancels)
settingsFontHint: The editor, results, console tabs and interface each have their own font. Changes apply immediately and are saved to fonts.json; check the main window.
settingsFontEditorPlaceholder: e.g. JetBrains Mono / Sarasa Mono SC
settingsFontFamilyResult: Font family (empty = follow the interface font)
settingsConsoleTabsHint: Font size of datasource and console names in the console tab bar; console names are 2pt smaller.
settingsUiFontHint: Text outside the editor and results: settings, console names, menus and buttons.
settingsConsoleSaveHint: Delay before the console text is autosaved after typing stops. Switching tabs, running, closing the window or quitting still saves immediately.
settingsPageSizeHint: Rows per page sets how many rows a query reads at most and the paging step. The current page is marked truncated once the byte budget is exceeded.
settingsBudgetHint: The budget accumulates text and binary cell bytes in the result set; a single cell also has a 1 MiB driver limit.
settingsLogHint: One plain-text file per launch (time / level / tag / message).
settingsPresets: Presets (write into the active console and save immediately)
settingsCustomPalette: Custom palette (empty colors use the defaults)
settingsAppearanceHint: Follow system keeps the desktop's light/dark mode, accent color and accessibility settings. Changes apply immediately.
settingsGpuHint: When off, CPU rasterization is used after restarting db-g; this can avoid black-screen flicker on some Linux/X11 drivers.
sessionNoVersion: This datasource does not provide version information
sessionForceStopped: Force stopped: the datasource did not respond; the connection was closed
sessionStopUnresponsive: The query did not stop, so the datasource was disconnected. Running again reconnects automatically.
editReadonlyNoWrite: This datasource does not support writes
editReadonlyNoTx: This datasource does not support transactions
editReadonlySingleTable: Only single-table queries are editable (JOIN and subquery results are read-only)
editReadonlyCrossSchema: Cross-schema queries do not support writes yet
editReadonlyLoadingColumns: Column information is still loading; try again shortly
editPkNotNull: Primary key columns cannot be set to NULL
editNoEffectiveChange: No effective change (the value is unchanged or the row was deleted)
editPreviewTitle: Commit {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} in one transaction; the whole set rolls back if affected rows differ
editPkReadonly: Primary key columns cannot be edited
statsUnsupported: This datasource does not support viewing statistics
statsExactRowsNote: Exact row count (not executed; may be slow on large tables)
statsCopySQLTip: Copy the statistics SQL; select part of the text and press Ctrl+C to copy only the selection
treeShownFirst: Showing the first {shown, number, ::group-off} of {total, number, ::group-off}
treeDDLUnsupported: This datasource does not support viewing DDL
treeUnsupported: This datasource does not support the object tree
treeCopyAllTip: Copy the whole DDL; select part of the text and press Ctrl+C to copy only the selection
connInfoCopied: Copied connection info (including the plaintext password)
sidebarTreeDragTip: Hold Ctrl and drag to reorder; drop between folders to move inside
paletteHexInvalid: Color must be #rrggbb (empty keeps the default)
syncHint: Connection info is encrypted; console SQL is plain text
syncSSHKey: SSH private key (empty uses the system ssh config / agent)
syncDirHint: Fixed in the local config directory; not stored in the repository
syncFirstPullHint: The first Pull clones the repository, checks out the config branch and imports data; commit and push local changes first.
syncPullOverwriteHint: Pull replaces the local configuration with the remote one; commit and push local changes first.
syncKeyAdvice: Generate and back up the key on the first device; later devices must import the same key, or the connections in the repository cannot be decrypted.
syncKeyLocalHint: The key stays on this machine; console SQL is not encrypted.
syncTransportHint: Transfer uses the system git: git must be installed and the existing SSH key must reach the repository.
syncSaveConsoleFailed: Failed to save the current console; sync canceled: {err}
syncGenKeyFailed: Failed to generate the sync key: {err}
syncSaveKeyFailed: Failed to save the sync key: {err}
syncKeyGenerated: Sync key generated; click Copy Key to back it up
syncKeyKCVBad: The key does not match the repository KCV; make sure it is the same key
syncKeyRemoteHasData: The repository already has encrypted data; import the same key. A new key cannot be created here.
syncKeyRemoteEmpty: The repository has no encrypted data yet: generate a new key or import an existing one.
syncKeyPlaceholder: Paste a 32-byte key as base64 or 64 hex characters
syncFindingsHint: Console SQL enters the repository as plain text; confirm these are not real passwords before continuing.
syncSaveConfirmFailed: Failed to save the confirmation record: {err}
extChangedPaused: The file changed externally; autosave is paused
extDeletedPaused: The file was deleted; autosave is paused
extChangedHint: Choose which side to keep before continuing; Cancel leaves the buffer untouched.
extNoDatasources: No datasources yet; create a connection first.
extBoundTo: This file is already bound to console {name}
aiEmptyHint: Ask about the current connection, schema or SQL. Results are not run automatically.
aiInputPlaceholder: Ask something. Enter for a new line, Ctrl+Enter to send
aiTimeout: AI response timed out; try again
aiModelMissing: Set the model name in Settings → AI first
aiAlreadyStreaming: A response is being generated; stop it first
aiSaveConversationFailed: Failed to save the AI conversation: {err}
aiSettingsHint: Defaults to local Ollama; any OpenAI-compatible service works.
aiBaseURLHint: Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1; OpenAI/DeepSeek: the matching /v1 URL.
aiAPIKey: API Key (may be empty for local Ollama)
aiAPIKeyHint: The key is encrypted with the local secret.key and written to ai.json; it never enters the logs.
aiModelsFailed: Could not load models; enter one manually
aiPrivacyHint: By default only the schema, current SQL and result shape are sent; history, errors, samples and DDL are opt-in.
aiAllowSamples: Send current result sample rows (up to 3)
aiAllowDDL: Send DDL for tables referenced by the current SQL
aiAutoTitle: Generate conversation titles with AI (one extra call; off by default)
aiNoModelsReturned: The service returned no model list
aiNoSQLBlock: The model did not return a usable SQL block
aiSourceChanged: The original statement changed; the fix was not applied
aiRewriteSelectFirst: Select the SQL to rewrite first
aiRewriteChanged: The original text changed; select it again
aiRewriteHint: Results are not run automatically; review the diff before applying
aiRewriteSendHint: Ctrl+Enter sends the instruction; the text is unchanged until you apply
aiRewritePlaceholder: e.g. make it parameterized / keep only needed columns / add a time range filter
aiContextWindowHint: Used only to trim prompts; set it to the model's real context length. Larger values send more schema/history.
aiContextDropped: trimmed {tables} tables · {cols} columns · {dialogue} dialogue · {ddl} DDL · {history} history · {errors} errors · {samples} samples
aiDialogueSummary: Earlier conversation ({n} messages omitted). User asked: {asks}
aiDebugEmpty: No AI requests have been sent yet.
aiDebugHint: Kept in memory only; prompt text is never written to logs or disk
planAnalyzeUnsupported: This datasource does not support EXPLAIN ANALYZE
planUnsupported: This datasource does not support execution plans
planAnalyzeHint: ANALYZE actually runs the current SELECT and may be slow; only SELECT/WITH is allowed.
